device.name: Spider Farmer GGS Grow Light Controller
device.notes:
BLE grow light controller for Spider Farmer LED grow lights. Marketed as requiring a cloud app but actually uses a simple local BLE protocol with (on older firmware) unencrypted JSON telemetry. $30-50. Companion app: Android com.sf.meizhi / iOS id 6476436750 ("Spider Farmer") — an ODM white-label app.
PROTOCOL: device advertises with name "SF-GGS-CB"; GATT service UUID is 0x00FF (both working codebases — ggs_ble.py in the cited cr0ssn0tice repo and smurfy/esphome-spiderfarmer_ble; only the cr0ssn0tice README table says 0xFF00). Device continuously streams JSON telemetry notifications on characteristic 0xFF01. Commands are sent as JSON write requests on 0xFF02.
APP CONFIRMATION (2026-08, com.sf.meizhi Android APK, Flutter/Dart): the app's libapp.so string table contains the full UUIDs 000000ff-…/0000ff01-…/0000ff02-… and no "0000ff00" string anywhere — vindicating the 0x00FF choice over the cr0ssn0tice README's 0xFF00. The JSON method names getDevSta, setLight, setBlower, getSysSta, getConfigFile, setMode, setOnOff, setDevTimezone, setDevActive and setDevDeactive all appear as app strings. Discovery is app-confirmed as a prefix match: the only name string present is "SF-GGS-" — no "SF-GGS-CB" exact string exists in the app. One discrepancy: the app carries "setFanj", not "setFan" — setFan below stays sourced from the community codebases (hardware-verified there), setFanj is listed with the undocumented methods.
ALSO APP-CONFIRMED (method names present as libapp.so strings; payload formats NOT recovered — string-table presence only, no Dart disassembly performed): - Scheduling/timers exist: setCustAD, setRunDays, setPlant, plus
  setPlantData, setPlantName and getCustPltLst. Upgrades scheduling
  from LOW (community-guessed) to app-confirmed-existence.
- Factory reset over BLE exists: setDevReset — reset is not
  power-cycle-only (see setup.factory_reset).
- WiFi provisioning over BLE exists: setWifi with a wifiPWD field —
  see setup notes.
- Undocumented, app-string-only: setConfigFile, getOtaInfo,
  setConfigField, getAlarmLog, getDeviceInfo, setFanj, and a wider
  family set covering the PS5/PS10 power strips and sensor-hub
  features: setOutlet, setPS5, setPS10, setTemp, setHumi, setCo2,
  setSensorHeating, setTempUnit, setBuzz, setHldMod, setLhtCtl,
  setNutr, setSpray, setWtrPump, setWtrSlt, setRange, setRoom.

SECURITY NOTE: the APK embeds an MQTT client (broker host sf.mqtt.spider-farmer.com) and ships an EMQX client certificate and private key as app assets — i.e. the cloud client credential is extractable by anyone holding the APK. Existence noted only; the cert/key material is deliberately not reproduced here. The local BLE path in this spec does not use or need it.
FIRMWARE QUALIFIER: unencrypted JSON holds for controller FW <= 3.2 (and PS5 1.7 / PS10 2.9 / LC 1.5). Controller FW 3.14 encrypts BLE payloads with AES-CBC (key/IV per product/firmware, unpublished) and this spec is largely invalid there — the community advises staying on FW <= 3.2 if local BLE matters.
TELEMETRY (notify on 0xFF01): JSON wrapped in a method envelope — {"method":"getDevSta","code":200,"data":{...}} where data is: ``` {"sensor":{"temp":25.4,"humi":55.2,"vpd":1.2},
 "fan":{"level":3,"on":1},
 "blower":{"level":0},
 "light":{"level":100,"on":1}}
``` - temp: temperature in °C - humi: relative humidity in % - vpd: vapor pressure deficit - fan.level: fan speed level - light.level: dimming level (0-100) - light.on: light power state (0/1)
COMMANDS (write JSON to 0xFF02): - Get status: `{"method":"getDevSta"}` - Set light: `{"method":"setLight","data":{"on":1,"level":50}}` - Set fan: `{"method":"setFan","data":{"on":1,"level":N}}` (level 0-10) - Set blower: `{"method":"setBlower","data":{"modeType":0,"on":1,"level":N}}` (level 0-100) - Also observed (pre-encryption firmware): getSysSta (device id + FW/HW
  versions), getConfigFile, setMode, setOnOff, setDevTimezone,
  setDevActive / setDevDeactive
- on: 0=off, 1=on; light level: 0-100
DISCOVERY: the app matches on the name prefix "SF-GGS-" (the only name string in libapp.so; app-confirmed). The prefix covers the family: the SF-GGS-CB controller, the SF-GGS-PS5 / SF-GGS-PS10 power strips and the SF-GGS-LC light controller. Whether a service UUID is present in the advertisement is unverified. No pairing or bonding required.
FRAME HEADER CAVEAT: notifications are reported to carry a structured 20-byte vendor frame header (per smurfy/esphome-spiderfarmer_ble parse_data()), not "Espressif fragmentation garbage": magic 0xAAAA0003, payload size, msgtype (0x0001 = plaintext JSON, 0x0002 = AES-encrypted), CRC-16 of the total payload, total size, block offset, block size, then block data and a trailing CRC-16; fragmentation/reassembly is a vendor protocol layer. This frame layout comes solely from that community ESP32 codebase — no corresponding structure (0xAAAA0003 magic, msgtype table) was found in the app's libapp.so strings, so it is UNVERIFIABLE from the APK without Dart disassembly. Kept here as the best available description, not as app-confirmed fact. The ESP32 MQTT bridge example at github.com/cr0ssn0tice/Spider-Farmer-GGS-Controller-MQTT accumulates fragments into a buffer and parses when `fan"` and `}}` are both present.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH for service/characteristic UUIDs (0x00FF/0xFF01/0xFF02), JSON telemetry format, getDevSta and setLight commands — sourced from the Python BLE control script (ggs_ble.py) and ESP32 MQTT bridge (Arduino sketch), corroborated by smurfy/esphome-spiderfarmer_ble and by the vendor app's string table; applies to FW <= 3.2 only (LOW for current encrypted firmware — the FW 3.14 AES-CBC keys remain unattributable: no key material was found in app strings, and recovering them would need Dart disassembly). MEDIUM: write format for fan/brightness/on/off fully confirmed. Scheduling/timer commands: EXISTENCE app-confirmed (setCustAD, setRunDays, setPlant, …) but payload formats undocumented — treat individual scheduling payloads as LOW.

credentials.notes: Cloud-free local protocol. Marketed cloud dependency is unused by the local BLE path.

factory_reset.effect: A BLE factory-reset method exists: setDevReset (app-string-confirmed in the vendor APK; payload format and exact effect unverified — presumed a JSON write {"method":"setDevReset"} to 0xFF02 following the family's verified envelope pattern, not hardware-tested). Power-cycling only resets the connection, not the device config.

steps.expect: Unverified. Method name confirmed present in the vendor app; payload and device behaviour not captured on hardware.
Device powers on and advertises with the SF-GGS- name prefix.

methods.description: Scan for the "SF-GGS-" name prefix, connect, subscribe to 0xFF01 notifications. Write JSON commands to 0xFF02.

steps.action: Scan for name prefix "SF-GGS-" or 0x00FF service and connect.
Subscribe to notifications on 0xFF01 and buffer/parse JSON.

setup.notes: No provisioning is required for local control: connect, subscribe to 0xFF01 for JSON telemetry, write commands to 0xFF02. The app does contain a BLE WiFi provisioning path (method setWifi with a wifiPWD field — app-string-confirmed, payload format unverified) used to join the device to a WLAN for cloud/MQTT operation; the local BLE path in this spec neither uses nor needs it.

rejoin.notes: No bonding. Any central can connect.

characteristics.name: Notify
characteristics.notes: JSON telemetry stream, wrapped: {"method":"getDevSta","code":200, "data":{...}}. Device sends fragmented JSON packets behind a 20-byte 0xAAAA0003 vendor frame header (msgtype 0x0001 plaintext / 0x0002 AES-CBC on FW 3.14+) — community-sourced only, not app-confirmed; see FRAME HEADER CAVEAT in device.notes. Buffer and accumulate until valid JSON with "fan" and "}}" is complete. Telemetry data includes: sensor (temp, humi, vpd), fan (level, on), blower (level), light (level, on).

characteristics.name: Write
characteristics.notes:
Command channel. Write JSON strings: - Status: `{"method":"getDevSta"}` - Set light: `{"method":"setLight","data":{"on":1,"level":50}}` - Set fan: `{"method":"setFan","data":{"on":1,"level":N}}` (0-10) - Set blower: `{"method":"setBlower","data":{"modeType":0,"on":1,"level":N}}` (0-100) - Also observed (FW <= 3.2): getSysSta, getConfigFile, setMode,
  setOnOff, setDevTimezone, setDevActive/setDevDeactive
- App-string-only (names confirmed in the vendor APK, payloads
  undocumented): setDevReset, setWifi (wifiPWD), setCustAD,
  setRunDays, setPlant, setConfigFile, getOtaInfo and the wider
  family set listed in device.notes.
Use write_with_response (GATT write request) for reliability.
